text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} spots Hatsune floating through the air while on his way home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}が家に帰ろうとしていると、
空を飛んでいるハツネを目撃した。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Thug 1
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Check it out.
We've got ourselves a sleeping beauty here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、見ろよ。
こんな所で女が寝てやがるぜ？

text_block_list.name: Thug 2
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Let's see if she's got any valuables first.
Then we can have a little fun with her, while we're at it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへっへ、
とりあえず金目のもん奪っとくか。
ついでに、ちょっくら楽しませてもらおうぜ。

text_block_list.name: Thug 1
text_block_list.text:
The hell's your problem, kid?
You wanna play hero or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？　
なんだ、
テメェ！
邪魔しようってのか？

text_block_list.name: Thug 1
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a minute!
Where'd she go?!
She just disappeared into thin air!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、おい！
話してる間に、女が消えちまったぞ！？
どこ行ったんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Thug 2
text_block_list.text:
You did something, didn't you?!
Ain't nobody gets away with taking our prey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメェがなんかしたのか？
よくも俺たちの獲物をっ！

text_block_list.name: Thug 1
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't you dare make a run for it!
Get your ass back here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
待ちやがれ！
逃げる気か！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text: W-what the?! Someone's sleeping right outside the castle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだ！？　
王城の前で寝ている奴がいるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text: That sounds suspicious to me! Arrest her!
choice_data_list: Drag Hatsune away from the castle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪しいヤツだ……
逮捕しろ！

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text:
Are you an accomplice?!
Then you're under arrest as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前もこいつの仲間か！？　
まとめて逮捕する！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Need more sleep...
About five more years' worth...
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん……
起きるには、
まだ早いよぉ。
……スヤスヤ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Hmmm?
Is that a monster I hear...? Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
んん～？
魔物の声がする気が～
むにゃむにゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Monsters can't go into people's houses. Oh, this must
be a dream! Phew, that's a relief.
All right, nighty night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
家の中に魔物がいるわけないし……
あ、
これ夢なんだ……
よかった～
じゃあ、
おやすみ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Why's it so shaky? Kinda hard to sleep, you know...
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
ゆれてる？
寝心地悪いよぉ……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Zzz... Glub glub... Ough...
Ooowww... Can't breathe... Glub glub...
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤスヤ……
ぶくぶく……
うぅ、
苦しい……
息できない……
ぶくぶく……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But... I'm still sooo sleepy... Zzz... Glub glub...
choice_data_list: Pull her out of the ocean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも゛、
ね゛む゛い゛……
スヤスヤ……
ぶくぶく…

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! What a great nap! Hatsune is back and ready for action!
Sha-shing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～！　
よく寝たぁ～！
ハツネ、
全快なのだっ！　
きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where am I? Why am I all the way up in the mountains?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
ここどこ？
なんで、こんな所に～？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh hey, it's {0}! You look exhausted. What's up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}くんもいる！
なんだか眠そうだけど……
どうかしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You saw me floating around in my sleep and were
too worried about me to get any sleep yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？
私が寝ながら飛んでたから、
心配して……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wow... You stayed awake just to watch over little ol' me?
Thank you so much, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっかぁ～
寝ないで、
見守っててくれたんだね！
{0}くん、ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes my superpowers go off when I'm sleeping, so I'll just
fly away without even knowing it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
寝ている間に超能力使っちゃうことがあって、
知らないうちにふわふわ飛んでっちゃうんだよね……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Watching over me must've been a real pain, so lemme do
something for you to repay the favor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんに迷惑かけちゃったから、
そのお詫びと、
見守っててくれたお礼しないと！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So what do you want? Your wish is my command!
choice_data_list: You don't need to thank me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かしてほしいことない？
なんでもしてあげるよっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aww, don't be like that! I'm gonna feel guilty until I do
something! C'mon, I'll do anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ～、そんなこと言わないでよ！
私の気が収まらないから！
ねぇ、何かさせてよぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You sure can! And if it's something I can do, then I'll do it!
Nooo questions asked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
　
私にできることなら、
なんでもいいよ！
どーんっと任せてよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: With my superpowers, most things are as easy as─
text_block_list.orig_text:
私には超能力があるから、
大抵のことは──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yikes! A-a monster?! We've gotta get outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、わぁ！　
ま、
魔物！？
大変だよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! You took care of me while I was sleeping, so I'll
take care of you now! I'll use my teleportation and whoosh us
on outta here! Whoosh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そうだ！
見守っててくれたお礼に、
今度は私が助けてあげるね！
瞬間移動で、
魔物から逃げちゃうよ！　
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
And we're here!
We were outta there in a literal flash! Pretty cool, huh?
Aw yeah! We did it! Love and peace!
text_block_list.orig_text:
到着～！
一瞬で逃げきっちゃったよ！　
すごいでしょ？
いぇ～い、ピースピース！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uh... I don't think I've ever seen this cave anywhere
before. Hey {0}, do you know the way out of here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
でも、
知らない洞窟に瞬間移動しちゃった……
{0}くん、
出口の方向わかる？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Right, of course not. I don't know... which way it
is... either...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わからないよね……
私も、
どっちに行ったらいいか、
わかんないやぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But we'll be oookie-dokie. Totally okay. I just have to
teleport us somewhere else! *yawn*
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
じょーぶ、
じょーぶ！
大丈夫だよ～！
また超能力で移動すれば……
ふわぁ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh... But I just teleported, and I'm just... so exhausted...
Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
瞬間移動したから、
また眠くなっちゃった……
むにゃぁ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, {0}. It's beddy-bye for me... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね、
{0}くん……
おやすみ……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Knowing Hatsune wasn't waking up for anything, {0} picked her up and frantically searched for the exit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくら待ってもハツネは目を覚まさず、
{0}はハツネを担いで
必死に洞窟の出口を探すことになるのだった……
